recommended_intent_frame.object_of_change: Input context / evidence supplied to an existing generative language model
recommended_intent_frame.intervention: Improve relevance, selection, organization, filtering or compression of that context
recommended_intent_frame.desired_outcome: More accurate, faithful, grounded, relevant and useful generated responses
recommended_intent_frame.boundary: Prioritize context construction/use and empirical quality effects. Model-internal context representations, positional architectures, acoustic generation and general output evaluation are background/adjacent unless they directly investigate supplied-context changes.

generic_relevance_rubric: Preserve the user-specified object, intervention and outcome; do not replace it with a neighboring phrase that is easier to search.

Primary relevance needs available evidence connecting the intended setting, context operation/use, and desired generation outcome. An unambiguous title can support a narrow claim, but missing content must remain explicit.
Architecture-only or context-capacity work is adjacent when the question asks about supplied-context content/selection; do not infer missing causal evidence.
Applied work in medicine, manufacturing or software can be directly relevant if the mechanism and outcome match. Application domain alone is not an exclusion rule.
Evaluation/attribution tools can support a diagnostic facet; distinguish measurement from a demonstrated intervention effect.
No title/content means uncertain, never primary. Partial/uncertain records remain separate and are not automatically supplied as answer evidence.
Do not claim a paper establishes improvement magnitude from title/metadata; effects and limitations need the supplied abstract or explicit later full-text reading.
